name: Avelorn
role: The one town: services, quest hub, every region's merchants and craftsmen, and paid transit to the camp of every field.
intro: The last city with people in it. Seven markets crowd the square where the Aether Fountain still runs clean.

name: Dawnmeadow
role: Dawnmeadow: Mosskin, Sporeling, Ambermite. 3 unique resident species.
intro: Aethrion irrigation still seeps under the grass. Since the Quickening, even the Mosskin herds charge travellers.

name: Moonbrook Vale
role: Moonbrook Vale: Brookfin, Reedstalker, Rotroot. 3 unique resident species.
intro: Brooks, reeds and a dying orchard. Something below the pump-house is pulling the water the wrong way.

name: Hollowroot Cavern
role: Hollowroot Cavern: Barkwarden, Hollowroot Warden. 2 unique resident species.
intro: Root-choked tunnels round a buried pump. The Hollowroot Warden waters nothing but itself now.

name: Graftwood Wilds
role: Graftwood Wilds: Dustwing, Craglet, Thornback. 3 unique resident species.
intro: Sylvara's grafted woods, abandoned two years ago. The garden machines kept working without their gardeners.

name: Elderroot Expanse
role: Elderroot Expanse: Lunari, Graftling, Sapdrone. 3 unique resident species.
intro: Under the elder trees, spores drift up from the Heartwood Engine below. The forest is choking.

name: Heartwood Engine
role: Heartwood Engine: Spore Matron, Heartwood Regent. 2 unique resident species.
intro: Sap conduits and the Engine's spore lung. Its Regent breathes rot where it once breathed light.

name: Saffron Wastes
role: Saffron Wastes: Sun Warden, Dust Revenant, Prism Wisp. 3 unique resident species.
intro: A desert that was farmland before the mirrors turned. The dead surveyors still walk the causeway they built.

name: Heliostat Vault
role: Heliostat Vault: Vault Mirrorguard, Heliostat Sovereign. 2 unique resident species.
intro: A sealed vault of mirrors. Every beam in Solenia ends here, and from here it is sent east.

name: Pearl Coast
role: Pearl Coast: Pearl Skate, Thunderhull Turtle, Squall Ray. 3 unique resident species.
intro: Terraces, pearl beds and lightning masts. At night the Drowned Signalmind sings under the water.

name: Frostfire Divide
role: Frostfire Divide: Frost Mite, Cryo Sentry, Drowned Signalmind. 3 unique resident species.
intro: Where the snowline meets the first lava. The Signalmind has grown a body and surfaces at the vents.

name: Cryocore Archive
role: Cryocore Archive: Archive Specter, Cryocore Curator. 2 unique resident species.
intro: Aethrion's memory, frozen solid. The Curator guards Archon Ysra Callow's warnings from everyone.

name: Cinder Expanse
role: Cinder Expanse: Vent Skink, Furnace Knight, Rivet Scrapling. 3 unique resident species.
intro: Ash and rivets over Emberfall's buried foundries. The Cryocore Archive lies beneath.

name: Veil Rift
role: Veil Rift: Riftling, Lattice Drone, Kiln Prime. 3 unique resident species.
intro: The edge of the tear in the Veil. Kiln Prime walks the heights, and its stokers still feed it.

name: Meridian Gate
role: Meridian Gate: Array Sentinel, Meridian Executor, Glyph Swarm. 3 unique resident species.
intro: The plazas before the Meridian Gate, thick with the Lattice's glyphs. The Heart lies below.

name: Lattice Heart
role: Lattice Heart: Lattice Weaver, Lattice Sovereign. 2 unique resident species.
intro: The Lattice Heart. The Sovereign waits behind its last door, and Aldric Venn's ward is failing.
